module_name: Education Access E-Learning Academy — Form One Mathematics
title: Form One Mathematics Learning Outcomes Framework
curriculum_reference: Tanzania Institute of Education — Mathematics Curriculum, 2023
purpose: To define the knowledge, understanding, mathematical skills, reasoning abilities and practical competencies learners are expected to demonstrate through the Form One Mathematics programme.

expected_outcomes: Recall relevant mathematical facts, definitions and terminology.
Describe mathematical principles using appropriate language.
Use estimation to evaluate the reasonableness of answers.
Demonstrate accuracy when solving numerical problems.
Select appropriate procedures for mathematical tasks.
Explain the reasoning behind mathematical procedures.
Identify and correct errors in solutions.
Attempt unfamiliar problems using logical methods.
Interpret solutions in relation to the original problem.
Explain mathematical ideas verbally and in writing.
Communicate reasoning using appropriate mathematical notation.
Apply mathematical knowledge to practical tasks.
Interpret numerical information in real-life contexts.
Use appropriate mathematical tools and instruments.
Demonstrate the relevance of mathematics to everyday decision-making.
Use feedback to improve mathematical performance.
Maintain an organised record of mathematical learning.

learning_stage_alignment.discover: Identify prior knowledge and recognise the mathematical concepts introduced.
learning_stage_alignment.learn: Understand and explain new mathematical concepts, definitions and procedures.
learning_stage_alignment.practice: Apply mathematical procedures accurately through guided and independent exercises.
learning_stage_alignment.apply: Transfer mathematical knowledge to practical and unfamiliar situations.
learning_stage_alignment.voice: Communicate mathematical ideas and explain solution methods.
learning_stage_alignment.journal: Reflect on learning progress, challenges and improvement strategies.
learning_stage_alignment.friday_assessment: Demonstrate achievement of the week's intended learning outcomes.
learning_stage_alignment.evidence_and_mastery: Present documented evidence of achievement across relevant learning outcomes.

outcome_assessment_levels.name: Not Yet Demonstrated
outcome_assessment_levels.description: The learner has not yet provided sufficient evidence of the expected outcome.
outcome_assessment_levels.required_action: Provide additional explanation, guided learning and targeted practice.

outcome_assessment_levels.name: Emerging
outcome_assessment_levels.description: The learner demonstrates partial understanding but requires further support.
outcome_assessment_levels.required_action: Provide structured exercises and opportunities for improvement.

outcome_assessment_levels.name: Achieved
outcome_assessment_levels.description: The learner independently demonstrates the expected outcome.
outcome_assessment_levels.required_action: Record achievement and provide opportunities for further application.

outcome_assessment_levels.name: Exceeded
outcome_assessment_levels.description: The learner demonstrates secure understanding and applies the outcome confidently to unfamiliar situations.
outcome_assessment_levels.required_action: Provide extension activities and more challenging mathematical tasks.

assessment_principles: Every assessment must relate to an intended learning outcome.
Assessment must evaluate understanding as well as procedural accuracy.
Learners must be given opportunities to demonstrate practical application.
Feedback must identify strengths and areas requiring improvement.
Assessment evidence must be recorded and reviewed.
Learners must receive additional support where expected outcomes have not been achieved.

implementation_requirements.teacher_responsibility: Interpret the learning outcomes, plan appropriate learning activities, assess learner achievement and provide corrective support.
implementation_requirements.learner_responsibility: Participate in learning activities, practise mathematical skills and maintain evidence of progress.
implementation_requirements.platform_responsibility: Present learning outcomes, support learning activities and maintain accessible assessment evidence.
implementation_requirements.quality_assurance: Review alignment between curriculum objectives, teaching activities, assessments and demonstrated learner achievement.

curriculum_alignment_note: These programme-level outcomes provide an assessment framework. Specific topic-level outcomes, terminology, content coverage and sequencing must be mapped against the official TIE 2023 Form One Mathematics syllabus before final curriculum validation.
completion_message: Successful learning in Mathematics is demonstrated when learners can understand concepts, perform calculations, reason logically, solve problems and apply mathematical knowledge independently.
